method_limit: This scorecard defines an independent review workflow. Blank fields, generated questions, and local build checks are not human review, approval, legal validation, or evidence that a gate passed.

gates.name: Independent calculation reproduction
gates.reviewer_role: Independent second reader with financial-model review experience
gates.objective: Reproduce the base collateral cap without using the workbook result as an input.
review_questions: What available proceeds did you calculate?
What unrounded collateral cap did you calculate?
Which assumption most affects the result?
Did any instruction or label create ambiguity?
pass_criteria: Reviewer documents independent steps and identifies any ambiguity
gates.required_evidence: Dated calculation steps, reviewer role, result, variance, conclusion, and permission to attribute the review role

gates.name: Unscripted presentation assessment
gates.reviewer_role: Observer who did not build the case
gates.objective: Assess whether the presenter can explain the recommendation, strongest opposing view, evidence boundary, and funding gate without reading a script.
review_questions: Why is the recommendation $3.0 million rather than $5.0 million?
Why can a conditional recommendation still be blocked from funding?
What is the strongest case for decline?
What evidence would reverse the decision?
pass_criteria: All four questions answered accurately without a script
Fictional inputs and public facts remain clearly separated
Observer records misunderstandings and follow-up actions
gates.required_evidence: Dated observer notes, reviewer role, question-level result, conclusion, and any corrective action

gates.name: Attributed external practitioner feedback
gates.reviewer_role: Authorized external credit, legal, collateral, or portfolio practitioner
gates.objective: Obtain substantive feedback on the decision, control design, or evidence needed to change the recommendation.
required_inputs: Relevant supporting artifact requested by reviewer
review_questions: Which decision assumption would you challenge first?
What specific evidence would change your conclusion?
Which control or remedy is operationally unrealistic?
May the reviewer role and response be attributed in the project log?
pass_criteria: Response comes from an actual external practitioner
Reviewer role and permission are recorded accurately
Feedback, change made, and remaining disagreement are logged without embellishment
gates.required_evidence: Dated attributed response or contemporaneous notes, permission status, resulting change, and unresolved disagreement
